item: A custody log opened on unreadable settings signs nothing; the Settings panel and reconcile result say what could not be read
key_paths: src/custody/log.py; src/custody/pending.py; src/ingest/pipeline.py; src/api/custody.py; src/static/app-ai-tools.js; src/static/locales/*.json; tests/test_custody_settings_unreadable.py
summary: Rows 32 and 33. A caller could read the custody settings fine while the log's own read a moment later failed, and the log then signed with the defaults (PQC off, local anchoring). CustodyLog now records prefs_unreadable and record()/rotate_signing_key() raise CustodySettingsUnreadable: ingest owes the entry and drops the batch log, a drain stops before trying any entry, POST /api/custody/log answers 503. The Settings custody panel shows a visible caveat when the store cannot be read (the switches then show defaults), and the gap check and record-gaps results say when a drain could not run on unreadable settings or an unread queue. Three strings x12.
